question: Which materials supplied impact production processes?

candidates.query: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(m:Material)<-[:REQUIRES|USED_IN]-(ps:ProcessStep) WHERE NOT EXISTS((m)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(:Supplier)) RETURN m.name
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(m:Material)<-[:REQUIRES|USED_IN]-(ps:ProcessStep) WITH m, COUNT(DISTINCT ps) AS process_count WHERE process_count > 1 RETURN m.name
